The right side is an enlarged map of Zhangmu Port, where it can be seen that the roads are relatively winding in the mountains, and the port passages are relatively concentrated. Then combine the materials: Zhangmu Port is Tibet’s only national first-class land commercial port, and the scales of border trade companies, floating population, and commodity transaction volume are relatively large, showing that its foreign trade status is important.
